_how_to_use: Paste each Google review into the list below, then run:
and commit. Newest first reads best.
text      the review, in the customer's own words. Do not rewrite it.
name      how it appears on Google. First name plus last initial is fine.
location  optional, e.g. 'Baton Rouge' or 'Commercial client'.
initial   optional, defaults to the first letter of the name.
An empty list removes the whole section from the site. That is on purpose:
no reviews is fine, invented reviews are not.
Only paste reviews the company actually received. Do not edit a customer's
words beyond removing an obvious typo.
